keep.quote: Every yes is the same yes now. So you stop looking at faces.

One word, "stay?", and he stays, and on Monday he pulls the pitch because you asked. Or he reaches that door with the only no you've got left, and whatever he does with it is his. The power, or the person?
Three dots. For once, you don't know what's coming.
